_doc: Small single snowy trees for the woods of the snow ground (bead bzc.87, docs/art/classes/trees.md): generate-image-v2 at 48 x 48 returns 25 candidates of a mixed subject; the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Layers: style, light, class-tree, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one small evergreen conifer laden with fresh snow, each image a different one of these: a slim pointed spruce with a white snow cap on every layer of branches, a fir with three stacked drooping layers heavy with thick snow, a narrow pine with a blunt snowy tip, a young bushy spruce dusted with snow. Dark cool blue-green needles #2a5a52, shadow #1b3d3a, snow white #eef4fa with pale blue shadows #b8c8dc on the right side, a short brown trunk #5a3a24. Narrow: about half of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.
recipes.negative: snowman, ground, snow mound, snow patch under the tree, ornaments, star, lights, person

recipes.subject: Subject: one small tree in deep winter, chunky and simple, each image a different one of these: a frosted larch with a full cone-shaped crown of bare golden-brown twigs #8a6a3c capped with snow, a white birch with a white trunk and a full round crown of thick snow-covered branches, a squat dark juniper with snow lying on top, a round snow-laden pine with a dense dark green crown #2f5a48. Snow white #eef4fa with pale blue shadows #b8c8dc on the right side. About two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.
recipes.negative: snowman, ground, snow mound, snow patch under the tree, ornaments, person, thin bare pole
